lumenatlas.worldmap.title: World Map
lumenatlas.worldmap.dimension.tooltip: Switch between the maps of the Overworld, the Nether and the End.
lumenatlas.worldmap.view.tooltip: How the map is colored: shaded terrain, flat colors, height bands or biomes.
lumenatlas.waypoints.title: Waypoints
lumenatlas.waypoints.export.tooltip: Save all waypoints of this world to a JSON file in lumenatlas/waypoint-files.
lumenatlas.waypoints.import.tooltip: Import every JSON file in lumenatlas/waypoint-files. You can also drop files onto this window. Duplicates are skipped.
lumenatlas.waypoints.import.none: No waypoint files found. Put .json files into lumenatlas/waypoint-files or drop them here.
lumenatlas.waypoints.empty: No waypoints yet. Press B in game to add one.
lumenatlas.waypoints.imported: Imported %s waypoints (%s already existed, %s files failed)
lumenatlas.waypoint.name: Name
lumenatlas.waypoint.error.name: Please enter a name.
lumenatlas.waypoint.error.position: X, Y and Z must be whole numbers.
lumenatlas.seed.title: Seed Map
lumenatlas.seed.singleplayer: Singleplayer world – the world's own seed is used automatically:
lumenatlas.seed.multiplayer: Servers do not send their seed. If you know it, enter it here:
lumenatlas.seed.cleared: Seed removed. Predictions are off for this server.
lumenatlas.seed.invalid: That is not a valid seed.
lumenatlas.seed.from_server.tooltip: Runs /seed on the server and saves the answer. You are allowed to use /seed here.
lumenatlas.seed.from_server.denied: This server does not let you use /seed (you need operator rights). Enter the seed by hand if you know it.
lumenatlas.seed.from_server.ok: Got seed %s from the server and saved it.
lumenatlas.seed.preset.tooltip: The world type the server was created with. Structures depend on terrain, so it must match.
lumenatlas.seed.status.disabled: Status: seed map is switched off.
lumenatlas.seed.status.no_seed: Status: no seed known for this world.
lumenatlas.seed.status.ready: Status: ready – %s structures predicted so far (%s areas queued).
lumenatlas.seed.status.unsupported: Status: this dimension cannot be predicted (not a vanilla dimension).
lumenatlas.seed.explain: Predictions use Minecraft's own structure placement code, so they match vanilla worlds of this version. They appear as dashed icons and are replaced by solid icons once you actually find the structure. Servers with world-generation mods or data packs, or worlds made in other Minecraft versions, can differ.
lumenatlas.settings.title: Lumen Atlas Settings
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.enabled.tool: Show the minimap (toggle in game with N).
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.size.tooltip: Size of the minimap in GUI pixels.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.zoom.tooltip: Blocks per pixel. Change in game with = and -.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.rotate.toolt: On: the map turns so that your view points up. Off: north is always up.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.cave.tooltip: Automatic: underground and in the Nether the minimap shows the floor around you instead of the surface.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.coords.toolt: Show your coordinates and facing below the minimap.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.biome.toolti: Show the biome you are in below the minimap.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.cardinals.to: Show N, E, S and W on the edge of the minimap.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.players.tool: Show other players that are near you.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.hostile.tool: Show hostile mobs as red dots.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.passive.tool: Show animals and other mobs as green dots.
lumenatlas.settings.minimap.margin.toolt: Space between the minimap and the screen edge.
lumenatlas.settings.worldmap.view.toolti: How the world map is colored.
lumenatlas.settings.worldmap.grid.toolti: Show chunk and region lines on the world map.
Animate zooming and jumping to search results.
Size of structure and waypoint icons on both maps.
lumenatlas.settings.worldmap.waypoints.t: Show waypoints on the world map.
lumenatlas.settings.structures.detect.to: Recognize structures from the blocks and mobs around you and mark them on the maps.
lumenatlas.settings.structures.predicted: Show structures predicted from the world seed (dashed icons).
lumenatlas.settings.structures.minimap.t: Show structure icons on the minimap too.
Write a short chat message when a new structure is found.
lumenatlas.settings.structures.types.too: Opens the world map; use Layers to switch single structure types on or off.
lumenatlas.settings.waypoints.minimap.to: Show waypoints on the minimap (with arrows on the edge when they are far away).
lumenatlas.settings.waypoints.world.tool: Show waypoint icons, names and distances in the 3D world.
lumenatlas.settings.waypoints.range.tool: Waypoints farther away than this are not shown in the world.
lumenatlas.settings.waypoints.death.tool: Create a waypoint where you die.
lumenatlas.settings.waypoints.keep_death: How many death waypoints are kept; older ones are removed.
lumenatlas.settings.advanced.scan_budget: Time spent per game tick reading chunks into the map. Higher maps faster, lower is gentler on slow PCs.
lumenatlas.settings.advanced.minimap_fps: How many times per second the minimap image is redrawn.
lumenatlas.settings.advanced.texture_cac: Map regions kept in video memory per detail level. Lower uses less memory.
lumenatlas.settings.advanced.reset.toolt: Deletes the explored map of the dimension you are in. Waypoints and structures are kept.
